before_action.text: 切口线和上腹部牵开方向核对过了，我负责保持腹壁张力。
before_action.text_en: The incision line and upper abdominal retraction are confirmed. I'll maintain the abdominal wall tension.

before_action.text: 圆刀片、吸引头和电刀，按进入层次依次递。
before_action.text_en: Scalpel, suction tip, and cautery. I'll pass them as each layer is opened.

after_resolution.text: 腹壁层次已经打开，先别急着深牵，下面还有可能贴着肠袢。
after_resolution.text_en: The abdominal wall is open. Hold the deep retraction; bowel loops may be adherent underneath.

before_action.text: 先沿十二指肠和胰头建立空间，肠袢向安全方向轻轻移开。
before_action.text_en: Establish the plane around the duodenum and pancreatic head first. Move bowel loops aside gently.

before_action.text: 宽牵开片和湿纱布在这里，深部吸引也已接好。
before_action.text_en: The broad retractors and moist pads are here. Deep suction is connected as well.

after_resolution.text: 主要区域看清了，我继续维持肝下和肠系膜一侧的暴露。
after_resolution.text_en: The key area is exposed. I'll maintain the subhepatic and mesenteric-side view.

after_resolution.text: 进入深部操作了，我会持续复核体温和循环趋势。
after_resolution.text_en: We're moving deeper. I'll keep reviewing temperature and hemodynamic trends.

before_action.text: 这层黏连牵着肠浆膜，先让牵拉停在分离面以外。
before_action.text_en: These adhesions pull on the bowel serosa. Keep traction away from the dissection plane.

before_action.text: Metzenbaum 剪、无创镊和细吸引，换这一组。
before_action.text_en: Metzenbaum scissors, atraumatic forceps, and fine suction. Switching to this set.

after_resolution.text: 已松开的肠袢逐段检查浆膜，不能把小裂口带进后续重建。
after_resolution.text_en: Inspect the released loops for serosal injuries before carrying them into reconstruction.

after_resolution.text: 精细分离器械仍需保留在台上，备用吸引管已经备好。
after_resolution.text_en: Keep the fine dissection set available. A spare suction line is ready.

before_action.text: 门静脉和肠系膜上静脉附近的关系，决定我们接下来需要多少暴露。
before_action.text_en: The anatomy around the portal and superior mesenteric veins determines how much exposure we need.

before_action.text: 我能维持目前这条视线；如果扩大暴露，会重新调整肠系膜牵拉。
before_action.text_en: I can maintain this view. If exposure is extended, I'll readjust mesenteric retraction.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的路径继续，任何血管边界不清楚就立即停下来重新确认。
after_resolution.text_en: We'll follow the selected route. Stop and reassess whenever a vascular boundary is unclear.

after_resolution.text: 血管环、直角钳和细分离器已放在待递位置。
after_resolution.text_en: Vessel loops, a right-angle clamp, and fine dissectors are ready to pass.

before_action.text: 这里紧贴门静脉，先找到血管外膜面，不要拿瘢痕当成安全层。
before_action.text_en: We're close to the portal vein. Identify the adventitial plane; scar tissue is not a safe landmark.

before_action.text: 血管剥离子和湿纱布，夹闭器械留作需要时备用。
before_action.text_en: Vascular dissector and moist pads. Clamps remain on standby if needed.

before_action.text: 我从静脉另一侧保持轻牵拉，深部一旦看不清就收回来。
before_action.text_en: I'll apply gentle countertraction from the opposite side of the vein and release it if the deep view is lost.

after_resolution.text: 我继续保护血管侧，胰头深部的牵拉角度可以重新调整。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll keep protecting the vascular side. We can now readjust traction on the deep pancreatic head.

after_resolution.text: 这一段靠近大血管，我会密切跟踪失血和灌注变化。
after_resolution.text_en: This dissection is close to major vessels. I'll track blood loss and perfusion changes closely.

before_action.text: 胰头深部的组织分界很薄，我把牵开力量再降一点。
before_action.text_en: The deep pancreatic planes are delicate. I'll reduce retraction force a little.

before_action.text: 双极电凝、细剪和替换吸引头已经放到无菌台前侧。
before_action.text_en: Bipolar cautery, fine scissors, and replacement suction tips are at the front of the sterile table.

after_resolution.text: 深部切离面已经形成，再复核一次血管侧，才能处理标本。
after_resolution.text_en: The deep division plane is established. Recheck the vascular side before handling the specimen.

after_resolution.text: 标本容器和方向标识已经核对，等你们确认切除范围。
after_resolution.text_en: The specimen container and orientation labels are checked. We're waiting for confirmation of the resection extent.

before_action.text: 标本取出时别带动血管蒂，我来保持深面的视野。
before_action.text_en: Avoid traction on the vascular pedicle during specimen removal. I'll maintain the deep view.

before_action.text: 标本托盘和湿纱布，准备接收切除组织。
before_action.text_en: Specimen tray and moist pads, ready to receive the resected tissue.

after_resolution.text: 标本方向已经随容器登记，交接会按病理流程核对。
after_resolution.text_en: Specimen orientation is logged with the container. The pathology handoff will be verified.

after_resolution.text: 切除床现在看得清楚，重建前再清理边缘的积液。
after_resolution.text_en: The resection bed is visible. I'll clear residual fluid before reconstruction.

before_action.text: 胰腺断端和空肠要自然靠拢，先看胰管位置和组织厚度。
before_action.text_en: Bring the pancreatic remnant and jejunum together without tension. Check duct position and tissue thickness.

before_action.text: 胰肠吻合用细针线和小持针器，按顺序上台。
before_action.text_en: Fine pancreatic anastomotic sutures and the small needle holder, ready in order.

after_resolution.text: 我保留肠袢的松弛度，别让后面的吻合把这一处拉紧。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll preserve slack in the jejunal limb so the next anastomosis does not pull on this one.

after_resolution.text: 这一组细针已单独登记，备用线还留在无菌台。
after_resolution.text_en: These fine needles are counted separately. Spare sutures remain on the sterile table.

before_action.text: 胆管断端就在这里，先确认空肠袢不会扭转。
before_action.text_en: Here's the bile duct stump. First confirm that the jejunal limb is not twisted.

before_action.text: 胆肠吻合细针线、无创镊和小吸引。
before_action.text_en: Fine biliary anastomotic sutures, atraumatic forceps, and small suction.

after_resolution.text: 吻合线周围再看一圈，下一步移动胃肠段时要护住它。
after_resolution.text_en: Inspect the full suture line. Protect it while repositioning the gastric and jejunal segments.

after_resolution.text: 重建已经进行到后半段，我继续复核保温与循环支持。
after_resolution.text_en: Reconstruction is well underway. I'll continue reviewing warming and circulatory support.

before_action.text: 胃端和空肠的方向要摆顺，别让新通路出现不必要的张力。
before_action.text_en: Align the gastric remnant and jejunum without unnecessary tension on the new passage.

before_action.text: 胃肠吻合器械与备用缝线已切换，牵开片先留着。
before_action.text_en: The gastrojejunal anastomosis set and spare sutures are ready. Keep the retractors in place.

before_action.text: 我托住空肠袢，胃端移动时不会牵动前面两处重建。
before_action.text_en: I'll support the jejunal limb so moving the gastric stump doesn't pull on the first two reconstructions.

after_resolution.text: 三处重建彼此的距离再核对一遍，接下来重点看扭曲与渗漏。
after_resolution.text_en: Recheck the spacing among the three reconstructions. Next, focus on torsion and leakage.

after_resolution.text: 这一关口我会重点复核生理趋势，需要暂停会立即报告。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll review the physiological trends at this checkpoint and call for a pause if needed.

before_action.text: 胰肠、胆肠和胃肠三个区域分开复核，不能只看表面干不干净。
before_action.text_en: Check the pancreatic, biliary, and gastric anastomoses separately, not just whether the field looks clean.

before_action.text: 冲洗液、止血材料和替换纱布都准备好了。
before_action.text_en: Irrigation, hemostatic materials, and replacement pads are ready.

after_resolution.text: 按照所选复核方案完成检查，发现可疑渗出就先处理再关闭。
after_resolution.text_en: Complete the review according to the selected plan. Address any suspicious leakage before closure.

after_resolution.text: 重建用的线材与止血耗材已经归入本台记录，数量会按实核对。
after_resolution.text_en: Reconstruction sutures and hemostatic supplies are logged. Quantities will be verified against actual use.

before_action.text: 我从胰周一直看到胃肠吻合区，再做最后一次术野巡视。
before_action.text_en: I'll survey the field from the pancreatic bed through the gastrojejunal anastomosis.

before_action.text: 开始最终清点，纱布、针和器械分别核对。
before_action.text_en: Starting final counts: sponges, needles, and instruments will be checked separately.

after_resolution.text: 无菌台上的清点项目已逐项回读，关闭器械可以更换。
after_resolution.text_en: The sterile-table count has been read back item by item. We can switch to closure instruments.

before_action.text: 最后确认引流位置，关闭时不要把任何管路压在深层缝线下。
before_action.text_en: Confirm drain placement. Do not trap any tubing beneath the deep closure.

before_action.text: 筋膜缝线、皮下缝线和关闭器械，已按层次排好。
before_action.text_en: Fascial and subcutaneous sutures and closure instruments are arranged by layer.

after_resolution.text: 腹壁分层关闭结束，体位转换前再核对管路固定。
after_resolution.text_en: Layered abdominal closure is complete. Recheck all lines before repositioning.

after_resolution.text: 术后转运所需设备和交接单已准备，等麻醉团队确认。
after_resolution.text_en: Transport equipment and handoff documents are ready, pending anesthesia clearance.
